extracted.intended_audience: Animal feed industry stakeholders, veterinarians, state agencies, regulated parties, and members of the public who may submit comments on FDA guidances (specifically those interested in AAFCO-defined animal feed ingredients).
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for submitting public comments and obtaining the FDA guidance on enforcement policy for AAFCO-defined animal feed ingredients, including electronic and written/paper submission procedures, confidentiality handling, and where to obtain the guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include docket number on all submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: All submissions received must include the Docket No. FDA-2024-D-2977 for 'FDA Enforcement Policy for AAFCO-Defined Animal Feed Ingredients.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Received comments will be placed in the docket and, except for those submitted as 'Confidential Submissions,' publicly viewable. Use the docket number when submitting via regulations.gov or sending written/paper submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submission process and posting
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit electronic comments via the Federal eRulemaking Portal: https://www.regulations.gov and follow the instructions for submitting comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments submitted electronically, including attachments, to https://www.regulations.gov will be posted to the docket unchanged. Because your comment will be made public, you are solely responsible for ensuring that your comment does not include confidential information you do not want posted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on including confidential information in electronic comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not include confidential information (e.g., medical information, Social Security numbers, confidential business information) in the body of electronic comments because they will be posted unchanged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you include your name, contact information, or other identifying information in the body of your comments, that information will be posted on https://www.regulations.gov. Examples of information you should avoid placing in an electronic comment include medical information, Social Security numbers, and confidential manufacturing processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for confidential submissions (paper-only)
rubrics_metrics.description: To submit a comment with confidential information that you do not wish to be made publicly available, submit the comment as a written/paper submission with two copies total.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One copy should include the information you claim to be confidential with a heading or cover note that states 'THIS DOCUMENT CONTAINS CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION.' The Agency will review this copy in its consideration of comments. The second copy must have the claimed confidential information redacted/blacked out and will be available for public viewing and posted on https://www.regulations.gov. Submit both copies to the Dockets Management Staff. Confidential information will not be disclosed except in accordance with 21 CFR 10.20 and other applicable disclosure law.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to keep name/contact information from public disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: If you do not wish your name and contact information to be made publicly available, provide this information on the cover sheet and not in the body of your comments and identify it as 'confidential.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information so identified as 'confidential' on the cover sheet will not be made publicly available except as required by law (see 21 CFR 10.20).

rubrics_metrics.name: Written/paper submission address and handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit written/paper submissions to Dockets Management Staff (HFA-305), Food and Drug Administration, 5630 Fishers Lane, Rm. 1061, Rockville, MD 20852 (Mail/Hand Delivery/Courier).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For written/paper comments submitted to the Dockets Management Staff, FDA will post your comment, as well as any attachments, except for information submitted, marked and identified, as confidential, if submitted as detailed in 'Instructions.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Public access to docket materials and viewing hours
rubrics_metrics.description: Received comments will be placed in the docket and publicly viewable at https://www.regulations.gov or at the Dockets Management Staff between 9 a.m. and 4 p.m., Monday through Friday.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the docket number in the 'Search' box on regulations.gov to access the docket. The Dockets Management Staff phone number is 240-402-7500 for in-person access inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness and comment period status
rubrics_metrics.description: Check the DATES section for whether comments are being accepted; for this document, 'Comments are no longer being accepted. See DATES for details.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document explicitly notes the comment period status; prospective commenters must ensure submissions are timely and in accordance with the dates provided in the Federal Register notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to submit comments on any guidance at any time
rubrics_metrics.description: You may submit comments on any guidance at any time (see 21 CFR 10.115(g)(5)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if a specific notice's comment period is closed, the regulation cited permits comments on guidances more generally at any time; consult 21 CFR 10.115(g)(5) for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance status and legal effect
rubrics_metrics.description: This level 1 guidance represents the current thinking of FDA on 'FDA Enforcement Policy for AAFCO-Defined Animal Feed Ingredients' and does not establish any rights and is not binding on FDA or the public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can use an alternative approach if it satisfies the requirements of the applicable statutes and regulations; the guidance does not change statutory or regulatory requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paperwork Reduction Act statement
rubrics_metrics.description: This guidance contains no collection of information; therefore, clearance by the Office of Management and Budget under the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 is not required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guidance does not impose PRA information collection burdens.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to obtain the guidance and request printed copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Persons with internet access may obtain the guidance at FDA guidance pages or https://www.regulations.gov; written requests for single printed copies can be submitted to the Policy and Regulations Staff, Center for Veterinary Medicine, with a self-addressed adhesive label.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Electronic access URLs provided: https://www.fda.gov/AnimalVeterinary/GuidanceComplianceEnforcement/GuidanceforIndustry/default.htm and https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents, and https://www.regulations.gov. To request a printed copy, send one self-addressed adhesive label to assist processing.
